title: Cinematic Memory
description: A woman in a silver satin dress sits in a vintage red theater chair, holding a lit candle in one hand and a film reel in the other. She gazes toward a large ornate window displaying a surreal night scene of a winged statue by the sea with floating lanterns, while film strips, a script, and a champagne glass rest on the table before her.
prompt: A woman with dark curly hair wearing a shiny silver satin dress sits pensively in an ornate red velvet theater chair inside a vintage room with heavy curtains. She holds a lit candle in her right hand and a film reel in her lap. In front of her on a table are scattered film strips, an open script, and a glass of champagne. Behind her, a large decorative window reveals a dreamlike night scene of a stone angel statue standing in the ocean under a cloudy sky with many glowing paper lanterns floating above the water. Warm light rays and string lights illuminate the scene, in a detailed cinematic digital painting style.
